_schema.description: Tag-61 6-Layer Acceptance-Pyramide cross-layer dependency-DAG drift allowlist. Each entry covers ONE directed edge (from_layer, to_layer) that is observed in the substrate but not declared in LAYER_DEP_EDGES (the DAG-spec). Allowlisted edges downgrade the verdict from DAG-DRIFT-BLOCKED (exit 2) to DAG-DRIFT-ALLOWED (exit 0). The mechanic is the analogue of the ADR-Errata CI-pin-skip-pattern (Tag-59 audit-pin-gate): legitimate substrate evolution between spec-updates does NOT block CI, but every allowance carries a tracked follow-up so the allowlist does not accumulate stale entries.

entry_schema.reason: non-empty string explaining why the cross-import is legitimate
entry_schema.follow_up: non-empty string with ADR-id / issue-link tracking the permanent DAG-spec update

out_of_scope: missing edges (declared but not observed) - those are SPEC bugs, not allowlistable drifts
soft-cite whitelist (handled by SOFT_CITE_WHITELIST in helper)
semantic-only edges (handled by SEMANTIC_ONLY_EDGES in helper)
dynamic-cross-check back-edges (handled by DYNAMIC_CROSS_CHECK_TYPES in helper)
cross_review_markers: Zone-M: layer-test substrate co-owned with Engineering personae via Tomás (Matrix-Lead)
Zone-N: Henrik (Internal Audit) audits allowlist entries for follow-up-discipline
